remarks: Discover exceptional convenience and comfort in this spacious, three-level townhouse featuring a private in-unit elevator that effortlessly connects all floors, from the attached garage to the sun-filled top level. Bright and beautifully designed, this home offers an open-concept main living area with a spacious eat-in-kitchen, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, center island, dining space, and sliders to a private balcony. Upstairs, soaring ceilings crown the generously sized bedrooms, including a primary suite with walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bath. The versatile flex space on the entry level is perfect for a home office, den, or additional family space. Set within a well-managed, pet-friendly community with a pool, fitness center, and dog-walking paths along side the peaceful creek and parklike setting and relaxing. This home is ideally located in the heart of Springdale-just steps from the train, bus, restaurants, shops, and cinemas.
